parts.given_solution:
∵\(\Delta ACD\)与\(\Delta BCD\)互为友好三角形
∴\(CD\)平分\(\angle ACB\)
\(\because \angle A=\angle B=45{}^\circ\)
\(\therefore AC=BC\)
\(\therefore \vartriangle ACB\)为等腰直角三角形
\(\therefore CD=AD=DB=\frac { 1 } { 2 }AB=\frac { 1 } { 2 }\times 4=2\)
